sourceLabel: IEEE 期刊通用稿件结构
description: 检查 IEEE 期刊文章的通用结构，并提供标题、摘要、关键词、作者身份、首页脚注和投稿文件要素；Transactions 差异仍需核对。
descriptionEn: Checks common IEEE journal-article structure and provides title, abstract, keyword, author-identity, first-footnote, and submission-file elements; Transactions-specific differences still need review.

submissionElements.label: 论文标题
submissionElements.description: 核对标题具体、简洁、描述准确，并尽量避免公式和不必要缩写。
submissionElements.descriptionEn: Verify that the title is specific, concise, descriptive, and avoids unnecessary equations or abbreviations.

submissionElements.label: 作者、单位与通讯作者
submissionElements.description: 核对作者资格、姓名呈现、单位和通讯作者。
submissionElements.descriptionEn: Verify authorship, name presentation, affiliations, and corresponding author.

submissionElements.label: ORCID
submissionElements.description: 核对投稿作者所需 ORCID。
submissionElements.descriptionEn: Verify required ORCID records for submitting authors.

submissionElements.label: 单段摘要
submissionElements.description: 核对摘要单段、自足、通常不超过 250 词，并避免脚注、引用和公式。
submissionElements.descriptionEn: Verify a self-contained single paragraph, generally no more than 250 words, without footnotes, references, or equations.

submissionElements.label: 3–5 个关键词
submissionElements.description: 核对 3–5 个标准化关键词或短语，并定义缩写。
submissionElements.descriptionEn: Verify 3–5 standardized keywords or phrases and define abbreviations.

submissionElements.label: 首页脚注
submissionElements.description: 核对收稿信息占位、通讯作者、资助和先前发表说明。
submissionElements.descriptionEn: Verify received-date placeholder, corresponding author, funding, and prior-presentation information.

submissionElements.label: 资助与致谢
submissionElements.description: 核对资助信息在首页脚注或期刊指定位置的呈现。
submissionElements.descriptionEn: Verify funding information in the first footnote or journal-specified location.

submissionElements.label: 伦理声明
submissionElements.description: 涉及人或动物研究时核对伦理批准和同意。
submissionElements.descriptionEn: For human or animal research, verify ethics approval and consent.

submissionElements.label: 正文结构
submissionElements.description: 核对引言、方法、结果、讨论、结论及具体期刊结构。
submissionElements.descriptionEn: Verify Introduction, Methodology, Results, Discussion, Conclusion, and journal-specific structure.

submissionElements.label: 参考文献
submissionElements.description: 核对文内引用、参考文献对应和 IEEE 样式。
submissionElements.descriptionEn: Verify in-text citations, reference correspondence, and IEEE style.

submissionElements.label: 完整投稿文件
submissionElements.description: 核对主稿、图表、补充材料和期刊要求的全部文件。
submissionElements.descriptionEn: Verify the manuscript, figures, supplementary material, and every journal-required file.

submissionElements.label: 投稿附信与特别说明
submissionElements.description: 核对原生姓名、先前会议版本和其他需在附信说明的事项。
submissionElements.descriptionEn: Verify native-language names, prior conference versions, and other matters that need cover-letter disclosure.

rules.message: 未检测到明确的引言章节，请核对 IEEE 稿件结构。
rules.messageEn: No clear Introduction section was detected; verify the IEEE manuscript structure.

rules.message: 未检测到明确的结论章节，请确认所选 IEEE 期刊和文章类型是否要求。
rules.messageEn: No clear Conclusion section was detected; confirm whether the selected IEEE journal and article type require one.

rules.message: 请确认摘要为单段、内容自足且不超过所选期刊限制，并核对 3–5 个关键词。
rules.messageEn: Confirm that the abstract is a self-contained single paragraph within the journal limit and that 3–5 keywords are provided.

rules.message: 请核对首页脚注中的通讯作者、资助信息，以及涉及人或动物研究时的伦理声明。
rules.messageEn: Verify corresponding-author and funding details in the first footnote, plus ethics statements for human or animal research.
